note: Booking searchresults.html captures from the map-search phase (a) probe (npm run probe:search). The probe proved the service worker CAN fetch search results — but only with the profile's Akamai cookies present (one real-tab visit to booking.com sets them; the challenge solves itself invisibly) AND credentials: 'include' on the fetch. Cold jar or omitted credentials gets the HTTP 202 challenge stub regardless. *.worker.html is a worker fetch (the feature's primary path, HTTP 200, 25 property cards); *.tab.html is a hydrated real-tab DOM read via scripting.executeScript (the fallback path, 25 cards); challenge-202.html is the refusal body whose markers lib/sites/booking/searchprobe.ts encodes. Phase (b)'s parseSearchResults grows against these.
